normal.text: I know it’s not very well defined, but to me what makes a game cozy is more about the vibes and the low stakes rather than the pacing. But I’m not very familiar with slow cinema. What would be your picks for cozy slow cinema movies?

normal.text: Planning a movie or game night? Pick the title before the amount. A tense horror pick lands differently when you are high, while a cozy one rarely goes sideways.
